verdict.rationale: Kick's documented MCP integration runs in the opposite direction from the story: docs describe Kick exposing an MCP server so external AI assistants (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini) can query and act on Kick data (kick-docs-15, kick-docs-16, kick-docs-17), not Kick itself connecting to and consuming tools from externally supplied MCP servers. There is no evidence that a user can plug arbitrary MCP servers into Kick so Kick's own AI can use their tools.
